title: Derived geometric stalk
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\geq1$ and the standing condition that $\ell$ is invertible on every scheme, as in [sk-def-purity-conv]. For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], a geometric point $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ whose field $\Omega$ is separably closed [def-kun-separably-closed], and $K\in D(X_{\Proet},\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)$, put

$$
K_{\bar x}:=R\Gamma_{\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,\Proet,\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n}\bigl(L\bar x^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n}K\bigr)\in D(\mathsf{Mod}_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n}),
$$

where $D(X_{\Proet},\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)$ and the finite-coefficient derived pullback $L\bar x^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n}$ are those of Definition [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and $R\Gamma_{\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,\Proet,\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n}$ is the derived-sections functor of Definition [pur7710-def-derived-sections]. The point $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ need not be of finite type over $k$.
